description: List every diagram in a Diagrammo Cloud space. Returns JSON `{ diagrams: [{ id, title, folder, chartType, version, updatedAt }] }`, sorted by folder then title. Needs DGMO_API_KEY (a space API key) in the server environment.

space_id.description: The space the API key belongs to (the key does not name it).

name: list_space_diagrams
